about_short_description.short_description: MEEZA is an end-to-end Managed IT Services & Solutions firm located in Qatar with the aim of being the depth IT Services provider.

product.name: MEEZA Managed IT Services
product.description: Outsourced management, monitoring, support, and maintenance of enterprise IT environments, including infrastructure, applications, service operations, and end-user technologies.

product.name: MEEZA Data Centre Services
product.description: Data centre infrastructure for hosting mission-critical IT, cloud, digital, and enterprise workloads, with Tier III-certified facilities and a stated 99.98% uptime guarantee.

product.name: MEEZA Cloud Services
product.description: Managed cloud and hybrid-cloud infrastructure services that provide scalable computing, storage, applications, and database capabilities from MEEZA’s Qatar-based data centres.

product.name: MEEZA IT Security Services
product.description: Managed cybersecurity services covering security monitoring, event analysis, incident handling, vulnerability mitigation, compliance support, and security technology operations.

product.name: Advanced Security Monitoring Service
product.description: 24/7 monitoring of critical IT assets and infrastructure that provides security alerts, incident tracking, regular reports, and historical analysis.

product.name: Oracle Exadata Cloud@Customer
product.description: A managed Oracle database cloud platform deployed in a customer’s data centre or local hosting environment to provide database performance, scalability, and data-residency control.
